notes: Stance leg = right (fixed before any baseline run): F3 derates the right knee hardest, and the loaded knee is the one that heats up.
Post-fault horizon is 5.0 s (v0.1 uses 3 s); the 'Falls after 3 s' column shows which falls a 3 s horizon would have missed.
Push tier upper bound (35 N) was set from the no-fault control alone (it survives 40 N x 0.15 s in all 8 tested directions, fails at 60 N toward the swing side).
realistic_brake_all_joints is a diagnostic ablation, not a baseline: same delay and finite holding torque, every joint braked.

provenance.note: runs_sha256 hashes the canonical JSON of all per-run records (each of which carries the SHA-256 of its full 1 kHz qpos trajectory). Same seed + same code + same MuJoCo build => same hashes. Different CPUs/BLAS builds may differ in the last float bits; compare verdicts and metrics, not hashes, across machines.
